# orbstack_machine (Data Source)

Read one OrbStack machine by name or id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orbstack_machine" "dev" {
  name = "dev"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Machine ULID. Set this or name.
- `name` (String) Machine name. Set this or id.

### Read-Only

- `arch` (String) Machine architecture.
- `disk_size_bytes` (Number) Disk usage in bytes reported by orbctl info.
- `distro` (String) Distribution reported by orbctl.
- `state` (String) State reported by orbctl.
- `version` (String) Distribution version reported by orbctl.
